review.decision: Partition mobile Live scrollback into bounded vertical Text chunks and cap pathological line widths below GPU backing-store limits
review.notes: PR #1954 joined up to 1,000 scrollback lines into one selectable RCTParagraphTextView drawRect layer (18,000pt = 54,000px on @3x iPhones), exceeding Metal's 16,384px 2D texture ceiling on any pane past ~303 lines and rendering a blank dark panel. Verify chunk row/column bounds, column stacking inside horizontal ScrollView, ANSI span preservation, and held-frame stability.

cases.description: Long Live scrollback partitions rendered text into bounded vertical chunks below GPU texture limits
cases.setup: Render an expanded LiveProgress preview with 1,000 captured terminal lines at 13-point font inside a 720-point viewport.
cases.action: Inspect the horizontal scroll content container, its vertical column wrapper, and every selectable chunk Text node across initial render, held scrollback, and incremental tail updates.
cases.expected: The 1,000-line capture renders inside a column View as bounded selectable Text chunks of at most 32 rows each so no single native paragraph layer approaches the 16,384-pixel GPU texture height limit on @3x displays. Unchanged leading chunks keep stable memoized props when new lines append below 1,000 lines, and held scrollback preserves the frozen chunks until resumed.

cases.description: Overwide Live terminal lines split at the chunk column ceiling while normal wide rows stay unwrapped
cases.setup: Render an expanded LiveProgress preview containing a 200-column styled row alongside a pathological 900-column styled row with ANSI color, bold, and CJK characters.
cases.action: Inspect the rendered chunk rows and styled spans inside LiveProgress.
cases.expected: The 200-column row stays on a single unwrapped line for horizontal scrolling, while the 900-column row wraps cleanly at the 320-cell ceiling without splitting surrogate pairs or losing ANSI color/bold styles, keeping every chunk within both width and height GPU texture bounds.
